summary_rationale.adjunctions-units-and-counits: Paragraph 1 was entirely this page's own development — its definition of an adjunction, transposition, the equivalent encodings, then a list of items 14–26 — with no declared dependency named anywhere; and paragraph 2 closed by surveying the companion page ("The companion computes units and counits, ideal–variety and preorder connections, …"), which SCHEMA §6 forbids. The replacement gives paragraph 1 the published category theory the page actually cites (whiskering and interchange, functor and comma categories, the size distinction, equivalences and adjoint equivalences, duality, universal arrows as initial/terminal comma objects, hom functors, representables, Yoneda, limits and colimits with preservation and the representable-preserves-small-limits theorem, plus free groups, abelianisation, free modules and Stone–Čech), and keeps the whole development, including the size-hypothesis distinction between the two RAPL proofs, in paragraph 2.
